summary.intent: Address a subagent's review findings on the v3 pre-mode work package (G), then implement follow-on packages: H (release-PR pre cycles, retiring E318) and M (`status --since` to catch changed packages lacking a changeset).
summary.outcome: Fixed the four G defects plus the pre.json key-order issue, committed them, and committed H with a real-binary lifecycle test. M was implemented with a diagnostic, flag, tests, docs and changeset; its final gate checks (pre-push, lint, doc-check) were started but results are not shown and it is uncommitted.

repo: Work packages live in separate git worktrees under .claude/worktrees/wp-*; each new one is started with ExitWorktree/EnterWorktree then `git merge --ff-only` of the previous branch to stack on local work.
Gate commands are `just pre-push`, `just lint`, `just doc-check`; tests run via cargo nextest, wrapped by a helper script c.sh.
Adding a field to StatusArgs or StatusOptions requires updating many test struct literals (e2e, status_check, lifecycle_e2e, single_package_root, cli.rs); StatusOptions now derives Default.
New diagnostic codes must be added to the schema_guard_test list (e.g. 'changed-without-changeset').
Retired error codes such as E318 are removed from docs/errors.md and docs/specs/*.json and recorded as retired.
User-facing changes need a .changeset entry created via `callisto add --package cargo/callisto-cli:<severity> --summary ...`.
The JSON status report omits `diagnostics` when empty, so test helpers must handle a missing key.
In v3 pre mode, the 'already applied' marker is deletion of the root changeset file (last step), unlike v2's pre.json, so interrupted runs need explicit detection.

code.finding: The archive-name map needed a cloned changeset (`note`) taken before iterating entries, because entries are moved out of cs.changeset.
check_partial_run (E121) was skipped in pre mode; head and working-tree pending-changeset checks only looked at top-level files, so pre/*.md had to be counted for v3.
PR attribution via `git log --diff-filter=A -- .changeset` also picks up version-commit additions under pre/, so pre/ paths must be skipped.
Rewriting pre.json moved unknown keys to the end, violating the key-order invariant; fixed so the file's own order is preserved.

workflow: A subagent reviewer's static-only findings (no build/run) were traced to concrete scenarios and fixed with boundary tests using the real binary.
Editing files while `just test` runs causes spurious failures; rerun after edits finish.
Python fix scripts are run with `python3 -I` from a separate tmp dir, following the safe-interpreter guidance.

friction: An in-flight `just test` run failed because files were being edited mid-run.
Compile errors cascaded from the new `since` field across many StatusArgs literals, needing several sed passes and rechecks.
Initial M test failed because the JSON report omits empty `diagnostics`.
A borrow/move error in aggregate.rs required a follow-up sed to clone the changeset.
open_items: M's gate checks (just pre-push, lint, doc-check) were issued but results aren't shown; M is not yet committed.
Reviewer's minor findings not addressed: is_changeset_path (release_decision.rs:728) accepts any pre/*.md in version commits, including outside v3 cycles.
pre.rs JSON schema allows null via Option and doesn't express the 'both fields or neither' rule.
An archived note with an unresolved package is silently orphaned at exit once pre.json is deleted.
`status` swallows ParseChangeset errors for notes in pre/ instead of reporting them.
Medium finding's `add` change was skipped since clashes are now handled at archive time; `add` still only checks the root directory.
